landing.eyebrow: For makers and small craft businesses
landing.title: Let buyers spin your craft.
landing.subtitle: Upload about 12 photos of a handmade piece and get a public store where customers can rotate it in 360° with real photos — and order on WhatsApp.
landing.step1.title: Shoot
landing.step1.body: Walk around your piece with your phone. We guide you through about 12 angles.
landing.step2.title: We prepare
landing.step2.body: Clean backgrounds, aligned frames, a brand palette and a bilingual listing.
landing.step3.title: Share
landing.step3.body: Publish your store, share the link and get orders on WhatsApp.
landing.f1.title: Real photos, never fakes
landing.f1.body: We never invent or “improve” how your piece looks. Every view is checked against your originals.
landing.f2.title: No account needed
landing.f2.body: Manage your store with a secret edit link. Nothing to sign up for.
landing.f3.title: English and Spanish
landing.f3.body: Your store and your listings speak both languages.
landing.f4.title: Order on WhatsApp
landing.f4.body: One tap opens a chat with the product message ready to send.
landing.fidelityBody: Each processed frame is compared with its original photo. Views that drift from reality are discarded, so buyers get exactly what they see.
landing.ctaBandTitle: Your piece deserves more than one flat photo.
footer.built: Built for the AWS Zero to Shipped hackathon.
footer.demoNote: This build uses demo data; the processing pipeline is coming soon.
capture.title: Shoot your piece
capture.subtitle: Place it on a plain surface and walk around it, one photo per marker.
capture.tip1: Use soft daylight and a plain background.
capture.tip2: Keep the piece centered and at the same distance in every shot.
capture.tip3: Avoid blur: hold still and tap to focus.
capture.name: Piece name (optional)
capture.notesPh: Only what you tell us goes into the listing.
capture.demoNote: Demo mode: photos stay in your browser and nothing is uploaded yet.

brand.subtitle: We picked a palette from your piece. Adjust anything you like; your next products will inherit it.
